question: What effect is attributed to merely hearing and knowing this teaching?
premises: The teaching is received as mere knowledge.
It is also received by hearing.
The fair-faced goddess is addressed as the recipient of this statement.
inference: Even mere knowledge and hearing of this teaching are presented as efficacious.
uncertainties: The main result clause continues in the following verse.
plain_english: O fair-faced one, by this mere knowledge, and by hearing it...
